images.title: Kabir's bars and Samaira's bars
images.purpose: Put Kabir's day and Samaira's day on two bar graphs of the same size, so the student can read each bar and compare the two children activity by activity.
images.composition: Two bar graphs side by side with the same marks 0 to 6 and the same activities: Kabir's bars 3, 5 and 2 on the left and Samaira's bars 4, 3 and 2 on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816, two bar graphs side by side, split by one thin construction grey #6B7280 vertical line (3 px) at x 760 from y 110 to y 740. Both graphs have the same size, the same marks 0 to 6 and the same three activities in the same order. Headings in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px): Kabir centred at (405, 70) and Samaira centred at (1133, 70). The name Helping at home is written on two lines, Helping over at home. LEFT GRAPH (Kabir): a vertical line (dark #2B2B2B, 4 px) at x 120 from y 620 up to y 130, with exactly 7 marks: a short tick (14 px) to the left of the line at every whole number from 0 to 6 (0 at y 620 and one mark every 80 px up, so 6 is at y 140), each mark numbered 0 to 6 at its left (right-aligned to x 90, dark #1F2937 bold, 32 px); a horizontal base line (dark #2B2B2B, 4 px) at y 620 from x 120 to x 690. Exactly 3 bars, all 100 px wide, filled amber #E69F00 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px), standing on the base: Reading: x 180 to 280, y 380 to 620 (height 240 px, which is 3 on the vertical line); Playing: x 350 to 450, y 220 to 620 (height 400 px, which is 5 on the vertical line); Helping at home: x 520 to 620, y 460 to 620 (height 160 px, which is 2 on the vertical line). Under the base, centred under each bar, its name in dark #1F2937 (32 px, first line at y 665). The bar heights, from the left, are 3, 5 and 2. RIGHT GRAPH (Samaira): a vertical line (dark #2B2B2B, 4 px) at x 848 from y 620 up to y 130, with exactly 7 marks: a short tick (14 px) to the left of the line at every whole number from 0 to 6 (0 at y 620 and one mark every 80 px up, so 6 is at y 140), each mark numbered 0 to 6 at its left (right-aligned to x 818, dark #1F2937 bold, 32 px); a horizontal base line (dark #2B2B2B, 4 px) at y 620 from x 848 to x 1418. Exactly 3 bars, all 100 px wide, filled amber #E69F00 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px), standing on the base: Reading: x 908 to 1008, y 300 to 620 (height 320 px, which is 4 on the vertical line); Playing: x 1078 to 1178, y 380 to 620 (height 240 px, which is 3 on the vertical line); Helping at home: x 1248 to 1348, y 460 to 620 (height 160 px, which is 2 on the vertical line). Under the base, centred under each bar, its name in dark #1F2937 (32 px, first line at y 665). The bar heights, from the left, are 4, 3 and 2. No number is written on a bar, no dotted line is drawn across a graph, and no other word is written in the frame. In all there are 6 bars (3 + 3). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a bar whose height differs from 3, 5, 2 for Kabir and 4, 3, 2 for Samaira, or the two graphs drawn with different marks
a number written on top of a bar, a dotted line across the graph, or any word such as Number of Hours or Activities
bars of unequal width within a graph
images.takeaway: Read each bar where its top meets the numbers: Samaira's reading bar is taller by 1, Kabir's playing bar is taller by 2, and the helping at home bars are the same.
images.description: Two bar graphs with the same marks 0 to 6: Kabir's bars Reading 3, Playing 5 and Helping at home 2, and Samaira's bars Reading 4, Playing 3 and Helping at home 2.
images.context: Concept image for Reading and Comparing Bars. It follows the idea of the book's bar graphs of two children's days and uses the numbers of this concept's own example: Kabir 3, 5, 2 and Samaira 4, 3, 2 hours.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student read each bar from the numbers on the vertical line, then lay a finger on the same activity in both graphs and say which bar is taller and by how many. The slip to watch: reading a number from near the bar instead of from where its top meets the vertical line.

image_decisions.why: Two bar graphs of the same size with the same activities let the student read each bar and compare two children activity by activity.
